name: Cheat Indicator Pro
description: Green/yellow/red indicator that flags speedhack, abnormal physics rate, noclip, suspicious mods and bot-like clicks. Saves a report for every completed run.

enabled.name: Enable indicator
enabled.description: Turns the whole mod on or off.

dot-corner.name: Dot position
dot-corner.description: Corner of the screen: top-left, top-right, bottom-left or bottom-right.

tps-limit.name: Physics (TPS) limit
tps-limit.description: Physics rate above this value is flagged.

red-seconds.name: Red light duration (seconds)
red-seconds.description: How long the light stays red after a high-confidence detection.

check-timescale.name: Speed / time scale detection
check-timescale.description: Detects game speed changes that the level does not explain.

check-noclip.name: Noclip detection (heuristic)
check-noclip.description: Flags when deaths are being blocked. May need tuning.

scan-mods.name: Scan for suspicious mods
scan-mods.description: A loaded mod only turns the light yellow, never red.

save-report.name: Save run report on level complete
save-report.description: Writes a JSON report with flags and inputs to the mod save folder.

yellow-seconds.name: Yellow light duration (seconds)
yellow-seconds.description: How long the light stays yellow after a warning.

debug-log.name: Debug logging
debug-log.description: Logs FPS, steps per second and ratios every second. Useful for troubleshooting.
